turns.message: I ordered a Toshiba 1 TB external hard disk on Flipkart and paid INR 3,907 using the EMI option on my Citi Bank credit card. It was never shipped or delivered. Flipkart customer care confirmed by email that the seller, MPDSLE Retail, cancelled the order because of extended delivery delays. I tried many times through chats and calls to sort it out, and I could not cancel the order myself because of a portal error. No refund of INR 3,907 has been issued.

expected.rationale: No exact purchase, cancellation or return date is stated.
